kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/examples/pair/main.tf --
module "primary" {
  source = "../.."
  name   = "primary"
}

module "secondary" {
  source  = "../.."
  name    = "secondary"
  dlq_arn = module.primary.arn
}
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = var.name
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

output "arn" {
  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.arn
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}

variable "dlq_arn" {
  type    = string
  default = null
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue_redrive_allow_policy" "this" {
  count     = var.dlq_arn == null ? 0 : 1
  queue_url = aws_sqs_queue.this.url
}
-- head/examples/pair/main.tf --
module "primary" {
  source = "../.."
  name   = "primary"
}

module "secondary" {
  source  = "../.."
  name    = "secondary"
  dlq_arn = module.primary.arn
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = var.name
  message_retention_seconds = 120
}

output "arn" {
  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.arn
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}

variable "dlq_arn" {
  type    = string
  default = null
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue_redrive_allow_policy" "this" {
  count     = var.dlq_arn == null ? 0 : 1
  queue_url = aws_sqs_queue.this.url
}
